title: Vör connector report
description: Canonical JSON contract every vor connector command (gh-overview, gmail-overview, calendar-overview, slack-overview) must emit as a trailing fenced ```json block in its final output, so the dashboard orchestrator can parse it without per-connector special-casing.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this connector's command ran.

status.description: Whether this connector actually ran successfully — distinct from whether it found anything. `ok`: ran fine, `items` reflects reality (possibly empty). `error`: couldn't run at all (not installed, not authenticated, connector needs re-auth) — `items` is empty BECAUSE it failed, not because there's nothing there. `partial`: ran, but one sub-check within it failed — `items` has whatever did succeed.

error.description: Short human-readable reason when status is `partial` or `error` (e.g. "gh isn't authenticated — run gh auth login"). Null when status is `ok`.

id.description: Stable identifier from the source system (thread id, PR/issue url, event id, message ts, etc.) — used for dedup, not required to be globally unique across sources.

urgency.description: Normalized cross-connector sort/group key. This is the ONLY field the dashboard uses to merge items across sources — everything else is per-item detail.

label.description: Short, free-text, connector-specific category tag for display (e.g. "CI failing", "Needs reply", "Needs review"). Not a controlled vocabulary, not used for grouping/sorting — cosmetic only.

title.description: The item's own short title (subject line, PR/issue title, event name, channel/thread name) — never a full sentence.

actor.description: Who it's from / who's involved (sender, requester, organizer, commenter).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the underlying item was created, sent, or last updated.

age_days.description: Days between `timestamp` and now — the "how long has this been sitting" metric.

summary.description: One plain-language sentence: what it's actually about and why it needs (or doesn't need) attention. Carries the specific reason `label` only tags.

url.description: Link to open the item directly, or null if none exists.
